## New assets — 2026-09-19 (Modak Big Belly emotion redesign)

3 new emoji sprites for the Modak "success beat" emotion states (see CHANGELOG/TASKS T58).
Sourced from Madhurima as ~1MB, 1254×1254px PNGs; downscaled via ffmpeg to match the existing
`emotion-*-game3` convention (500×500px) and re-encoded to webp:

| File | Size before | Size after (png / webp) | Used by |
|------|---|---|---|
| emotion-pleased-game3 | 690 KB | 139 KB / 15.6 KB | FlowerJourneyGame2 (leaves/bush success) |
| emotion-excited-game3 | 1.1 MB | 218 KB / 21.4 KB | FlowerJourneyGame2 (branch success) |
| emotion-relieved-game3 | 733 KB | 143 KB / 15.9 KB | FlowerJourneyGame2 (marsh/crossing success) |

Still larger on the `.png` side than the pre-existing `emotion-angry/sad/worried/happy-game3`
set (~30-44 KB each) since ffmpeg's default PNG compression is weaker than whatever pipeline
made those originals — the app only imports the `.webp` versions, so this doesn't affect
runtime payload, but worth a proper `pngquant`/`sharp` pass later if the `.png` fallbacks
matter (e.g. Safari edge cases).

## How to generate this file

Run this in Claude Code for each scene:
"Read IMAGE_AUDIT.md and sceneRegistry.js.
Then read [scene file path].
Also scan the scene's folder for all image files.
Fill in the scene section below.
Update the SUMMARY section when done."

Always start with Scene 01 (NewModakSceneV7) as benchmark.

---

## What Claude Code checks per scene

### 1. Background images
- Are all BG images SVG format? Flag any PNG or JPG used as BG.
- Is the SVG inline or imported as a file?
- Is the BG responsive — does it use viewBox correctly?

### 2. All images used
- List every image imported or referenced in the JSX
- Note format: SVG / PNG / JPG / WebP
- Note usage: background / character / icon / decoration / game asset
- Flag any PNG or JPG that could be replaced with SVG

### 3. Duplicates
- Note if the same image file is used in multiple scenes
- Flag if the same visual is saved as separate files per scene (consolidate candidates)

### 4. Broken references
- Does every imported image file actually exist in the folder?
- Flag any import path that looks incorrect or points to a missing file

### 5. File size
- Flag any single image over 200kb
- Flag any scene whose total image weight exceeds 1mb

Partial-alpha edge RGB MAE limit 5/255; alpha-plane MAE limit 1/255. **15/22 require review**, sorted first in the comparison page. No candidate is automatically approved. Visual contact sheets covered every image at display size on light and dark backgrounds; no obvious new halos or strong background banding there. Peacock/feather detail softens at 3× zoom and remains flagged. Small text is not present in these converted images.

[One Scene 3 comparison page — real-size, 3× zoom, background toggles](C:\Users\Madhurima Agarwal\.codex\visualizations\2026\10\15\01a13fc9-5ab2-7bd3-a288-d8dc8bd64318/Scene-3-Comparison.html)

**Measured production baseline from Phase 1:** Slow 4G, cache disabled, 1024×768 DPR2: opening 20.844–21.532 s and 3.627–4.059 MB completed response bytes. A reliable fully drawn Eyes time was NOT obtained (strict retry timed out at 180 s); do not use the rejected 46.632 s Eyes sample as a baseline. No new production build or after-load result before visual approval/import switch. Before/after remeasurement must use the same corrected endpoint; neither speedup nor transferred-byte saving is claimed yet.

**Left alone:** shared symbol WebPs, public/images PNGs/poses, sidebar/card art and tutorial hand need separate approval; already-small lossy Tusk images untouched. No hidden games mounted. No game logic, voice, timers, resume or Play Again changes. The unused 197 KB ganesha-character preload is a measured removal candidate, still unchanged. The old private sibling build was removed after checking running processes; its log moved out of the repo. No commit/push.

**Rollout gate:** approve this page → image-import/preload-only changes after a fresh diff → one private production build at a time → remeasure → Madhurima tests/approves Scene 3 → short Phase 1 reports for Shloka Scene2 then Scene3 → review. Thereafter resume the remaining requested scene order (Scene1, Modak, four About Me Hut scenes, Pond, Sacred Assembly, Sarvakaryeshu, Finale). All 13 live scenes remain in scope; no other scene has been converted.
